title.rendered: Puerto Rico R&D expenditures dropped 8.3% in fiscal 2025

excerpt.rendered: Puerto Rico’s government research and development spending fell 8.3% in fiscal 2025, while mainland states recorded a 4.3% increase, according to federal data. #NewsismyBusiness

title.rendered: Puerto Rico telecom chief says digital overhaul stalled

excerpt.rendered: Osvaldo Soto-García says limited staffing and funding have slowed plans to move company filings online and make consumer complaints easier to pursue. #NewsismyBusiness
